name: decline-dumbbell-situp.html
instructions:
1. Set a decline bench at around a 30 degree angle (you can go higher for more intensity).
2. Grab 2 light dumbbells and position yourself on the incline bench with your back flat against the bench and dumbbells at shoulder height, with palms facing your feet.
3. Tense your abs to pull yourself up while twisting and bringing your right arm forward with the dumbbell.
4. At the top of the movement you should be sitting upright with your right arm across your left knee.
5. Lower back down to the starting position slowly and repeat with the left arm forward.
